descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S25 Side by side with prototype p72: scan screens and the photo-reading prompts

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 The design matches the prototype attached to the ticket (RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html). (TFA-92580 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • T4 The prototype's photo-reading instruction text is ported word for word. Only the request format changes, to fit Gemini's API. (TFA-94425 AC 2; TFA-94425 AC 3; TFA-94425 AC 4)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given handoff-docs/RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html and the app on main

When Compare the scan sheet, result list, duplicate review and Add form with the prototype. Diff the census-rounding / census-snf prompts (and the other two vision prompts) with the prototype strings

Then Screens match the prototype. The prompts are identical apart from whitespace

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): A person compares the screens side by side. The prompt diff (whitespace-normalised) must be empty. Where p72 conflicts with the UAT's duplicate prompt and flags, that is Q1/Q2, not a T1 Fail

Where it ran: local code-review (judged by reading the code); test method STATIC · Static check (build output / scan); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S25 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane code-review.

Test method: STATIC · Static check (build output / scan) (STATIC (prompt-parity diff: p72 HTML vs library .md, whitespace-normalised)); secondary: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local (prompt diff) / both (screens); Source: code-review.
